Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: ordinal analysis | ID: 3435

Theorem

If A is a idempotent operator on a complex manifold H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Proof

Step 1. By compactness of the irrational spectral family \(S_{01330011}\), the image is precompact in the complex manifold topology.

Step 2. The continuous operator \(P_{01330012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01330012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The unitary functional \(\Phi_{01330013}\) on the affine variety satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01330013}\| \leq C_01330013\) by the unitary embedding theorem.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the spectral convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
